name: Negative-funding capitulation long — perp-discount flip trigger (funding + basis cross-up, 1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the fastest expression of the negative-funding squeeze thesis, event-triggered on a 1h clock. We wait for deeply negative funding_rate (crowded shorts paying longs) and then enter the SPOT long (direction +1) when perp_spot_basis crosses UP through a fitted floor — the moment the perp discount to spot starts closing is the first tick of the short-squeeze as shorts begin to cover. This is distinct from variants 07/08: it uses a cross_up EVENT on basis as the ignition trigger (timing the turn) rather than a static oversold level, and holds only ~0.25-0.5d for the fast covering leg. The long collects the negative-funding carry (funding_feature) into the squeeze. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if the basis cross-up trigger fires too rarely alongside negative funding to clear effective-N. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the fast squeeze does not beat a plain basis-cross-up long without the negative-funding gate. DISCONFIRMER 3: kill if net-of-fee edge dies once real 6bps taker fees hit the 1h turnover.
catalyst: deeply negative funding then perp basis crosses up off its discount — shorts begin covering, a spot long rides the squeeze.
